newsitem.title: UK: Fergie faces embarrassment over healer's memoirs.
newsitem.headline: Fergie faces embarrassment over healer's memoirs.

text.p: Britain's ill-starred Duchess of York faces new embarrassment in the form of a "shocking" set of memoirs penned by her former psychic healer, the Daily Mirror newspaper said on Wednesday.
The tabloid said the tome by Greek healer Vasso Kortesis was "the most explosive book ever written about the monarchy" and would reveal some of the royal family's deepest secrets.
The former Sarah Ferguson, dubbed "Fergie" by the popular press, unburdened herself to the healer over a three-year period in the early 1990s when her marriage to Prince Andrew was falling apart.
The Mirror said the book contained accounts about Princess Diana, Queen Elizabeth, her husband Prince Philip and Fergie herself.

The duchess may well try to ban the book before it appears. Last month she won a court injunction preventing publication of a kiss-and-tell book about her relationship with American businessman John Bryan.

She has never been able to live down the worldwide publication in 1992 of pictures showing Bryan sucking her toes at a French villa shortly after her separation from Andrew, Queen Elizabeth's second son. The couple divorced earlier this year.
British tabloids have regularly taken Fergie to task for a lifestyle of expensive holidays and shopping sprees.
Earlier this year newspapers reported that the Queen had refused to bail the duchess out of debts said have reached up to three million pounds ($4.5 million).
